regimes.fixed_top: gwlinp >= z(1) - 1e-4; prescribed top-head route returns
regimes.profile_search: NN starts 0; while z(NN+1)>gwlinp and NN<numnod, increment NN
regimes.near_node_snap: when z(NN)-gwlinp < 1e-4 and NN>0, set gwlinp=z(NN), NN=NN-1

interpretation: Pure source-regime classification only; no flux profile, conductivity, head state or transition owner is admitted.
